package.name: usv_mpc_cpp
package.description: Compatibility package for the frozen research batches. The original usv_mpc_cpp was renamed into usv_mpc/usv_nmpc on 2026-11-12; the frozen W2 wiring suites still build `find_package(usv_mpc_cpp)`. This package installs exactly the headers restored from R40 (SHA-256 verified) and exports them as an INTERFACE target. It contains no implementation: every symbol resolves in usv_mpc / usv_nmpc at link time.
